note: Per-post tracking paths for Cloudflare Web Analytics. Query strings are ignored, so each campaign gets its own path. posts keys are MMDD (optional letter suffix for a second post that day, e.g. 1026b) and create both /fbMMDD and /liMMDD. generic keys are /fb, /li, /wa. Pages are noindex and must stay out of sitemap.xml. 1028 and 1104 originally linked to slugs that now 200 as moved stubs; those dates use the merged live pages instead.
